instruction: Center-align all text in the header row to make it look more professional.

parameters.window_name: New Large Language Models.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc

metadata.explanation: Task requires center-aligning the header row. The evaluator checks cell B1 (middle column of header) to verify center alignment is applied. This is a representative check for the header formatting.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: Instruction requires center-aligning ALL text in the header row, but evaluator only checks cell B1
Single-cell verification vs entire row requirement: Semantic mismatch between instruction scope (entire row) and verification scope (one cell)
False positive risk: If user center-aligns only B1 but not other header cells (A1, C1, D1, etc.), the evaluator would incorrectly pass
Getter and metric logic is correct for what it does: Properly extracts alignment and checks for 'center', but applied to insufficient scope
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Modify getter to extract alignment info for all cells in the header row (e.g., row 1), not just B1
Update metric to verify that ALL cells in the header row have center alignment, not just one representative cell
Alternative: Change instruction to specify 'Center-align cell B1 in the header row' to match the current evaluator scope
Consider using a loop in the getter to check cells A1, B1, C1, D1, etc. until reaching an empty cell, then return a list of alignments for the metric to verify
